title: Brian's Song
description: Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) of the Chicago Bears befriends his teammate Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher), who is dying of cancer.

title: The Nines
description: An actor is under house arrest, a TV show chronicles a sitcom production, and a video-game designer and his family become stranded in the woods.

title: Agnes of God
description: A psychiatrist (Jane Fonda) probes the mind of a nun (Meg Tilly) in whose room has been found a dead newborn infant.

title: Touch the Top of the World
description: Climber Erik Weihenmayer becomes the first blind person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Buddy
description: An animal lover raises a baby gorilla in the 1920s Brooklyn, along with a slew of geese, dogs, horses and chimps.

title: The Master of Disguise
description: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.

title: Sunset
description: Tom Mix (Bruce Willis) and Wyatt Earp (James Garner) solve a murder mystery at the Academy Awards in 1929 Hollywood.

title: Conspiracy
description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears.

title: No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).

title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) rises to music stardom, falls victim to drug abuse, and finds the love of a good woman (Jenna Fischer).

title: Julie & Julia
description: A woman in Queens, N.Y., sets a deadline of one year to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's famous cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking."

title: Crossroads
description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

title: Fire on the Mountain
description: A developer (Ron Howard) helps an old rancher (Buddy Ebsen) defend land the Army wants for a missile base.

title: Bless Me, Ultima
description: A young man and an elderly medicine woman try to end the battle between good and evil that is waging out of control through their village during World War II.

title: The Waterdance
description: Paralyzed by a hiking accident, a young writer (Eric Stoltz) struggles to adjust among other men in a hospital ward.

title: Raising Waylon
description: A restaurateur (Thomas Gibson) and a photographer (Poppy Montgomery) learn surprising things about themselves while taking care of their 9-year-old godchild.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
description: A scientist (Jeffrey Nordling) and his team fly down a volcano and become lost in an inner world of chaos and wonders.

description: A has-been TV star (Hulk Hogan) helps children fight villains (Loni Anderson, Jim Varney) who have taken over an amusement park.

title: 3 Ninjas Knuckle Up
description: Three boys stop a polluter's (Charles Napier) henchmen with martial arts learned from their Asian grandfather (Victor Wong).

description: Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) of the Chicago Bears befriends his teammate Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher), who is dying of cancer.

title: Murphy's Romance

description: A snake hunter (Jon Voight) commandeers a documentary crew (Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube) in the Brazilian jungle, forcing them to battle a monster boa.
